claim_boundary: SHDocs flat FUNSD documents with ground-truth text boxes and 8-bit SDK channel exports; virtual angles are synthesized from the four exported channels, noise is injected, not recorded. Nothing here is an industrial spray-code, curved-surface, polarized-source or dynamic-line result, and none of it opens the formal Gate 1.

noise_model.caveat: Calibrated on PDD High (a different sensor, no text). The blind redundancy estimate on SHDocs exports gives an effective level far below PDD High, so the doses are anchored on pixel distance to the real channels, not on sensor noise.
noise_model.form: variance = a*x + b with x in [0,1]; sigma in 8-bit gray = 255*multiplier*sqrt(var)

alternative_accuracy.criterion: exact rate of the noisy copy bracketing the mean exact rate of the real I45/I90/I135 (selected post hoc, after the dose-response was visible)

pixel_distance.criterion: to-base RMS of the noisy copy within the real I0-to-other-channel median RMS range (nearest dose on each side if none inside)
